items.name: Sparring
items.desc: Enemies have less HP and hit softer; bots are Punching Bags. Rest heals 50%. Runs are flagged 'Sparring' on the boards.

items.name: Amateur
items.desc: The standard card. Journeyman bots, standard rewards and records.

items.name: Pro
items.desc: Enemies +20% HP, +25% damage; Contender bots parry. Scrip x1.15, Clout x1.4.

items.name: Title Shot
items.desc: Enemies +40% HP, +50% damage; Headliner bots use their techniques well. Scrip x1.3, Clout x2. Required for Dose 6+ records.

items.name: Punching Bag
items.desc: Reaction 0.5 s, many mistakes, never parries or punishes. A button-masher beats it.

items.name: Journeyman
items.desc: Reaction 0.36 s, 18% mistakes, rare parries, punishes now and then.

items.name: Contender
items.desc: Reaction 0.25 s, 10% mistakes, real combos, parries and punishes now and then.

items.name: Headliner
items.desc: Reaction 0.15 s, 5% mistakes: blocks strings, parries, punishes button-mashing, uses techniques well.

items.name: Hall-of-Famer
items.desc: Reaction 0.09 s, 1% mistakes, reads charge-ups and mashing. Dose 10 and custom matches only.
